text: Generates a hosted MCP server directly from an OpenAPI document or a TypeScript Functions project
quote: Built — the Control Plane generates the server itself from a first-party source: an OpenAPI document or a TypeScript Functions project.

text: Supports bringing your own OAuth 2.0 provider (Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, or custom) for authenticating tool access
quote: you can use any OAuth 2.0 provider you have set up (such as Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, or your own OAuth server)

text: Can front a third-party-run MCP server with a governed endpoint, applying access control, audit, and credential handling without modifying the upstream server
quote: Put a governed endpoint in front of an MCP server someone else runs, so access control, audit, and upstream credentials apply without changing the upstream.

text: Lets users install toolsets as MCP servers directly into AI agents via the CLI, with self-updating CLI tooling
quote: install toolsets as MCP servers in AI agents, and keep the CLI itself up to date

text: Captures a raw execution log of every tool call across hosted, tunneled, and shadow MCP servers, skills, and local tools
quote: the raw execution log for every tool call the platform observes across hosted MCP servers, tunneled and shadow MCP servers, skills, and local tools

text: Supports skills as versioned SKILL.md manifests containing reusable instructions agents can load on demand
quote: A skill is a versioned `SKILL.md` manifest: reusable instructions that agents load on demand.

text: Admins can find/add servers, finish setup, publish, author skills, manage risk policies, and view observability from within an MCP client
quote: An org admin working in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or another MCP client can find and add MCP servers, finish their setup, put them on a plugin, author skills, manage risk policies, and read observability data without opening the dashboard

text: Provides an in-dashboard agent harness to pick a server, authenticate, chat with a model invoking its tools, and inspect logs before connecting a real client
quote: An in-dashboard agent harness for testing MCP servers before connecting a real client: pick a server, authenticate, chat with a model that calls the tools, and inspect the logs.

text: Tracks AI usage across teams by tokens or cost, supports deep-diving expensive sessions, setting budgets, and measuring tool effectiveness
quote: Track AI usage across teams and measure impact with either tokens or cost. Deep dive expensive sessions, create budgets and measure tool effectiveness.

text: Enforces team, server, and tool-level permissions via RBAC and OAuth 2.1, synced with enterprise IDPs like Okta, Azure AD, or Google Workspace
quote: Team, server, and tool level permissions enforced through RBAC and Oauth2.1. Synced to your enterprise IDP (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, etc.).

text: Enables consolidating hundreds of MCP servers under a single gateway for organization-wide rollout
quote: MoonPay brought 200+ MCP servers under the MCP Gateway, going from proof of concept to a company-wide rollout in 30 days.

text: Blocks unsanctioned shadow MCP servers by default
quote: unsanctioned shadow MCP servers are blocked by default
